blocks.text: INN NEWS - Appointment of Silfester Matutina, General Chairman of White Solidarity (Solmet), as the Commissar of the Indonesian P. T Rajawali Resantara (ID Food) by Secretary of State's Property (BUMN) Erick Thohir in March 2025 has triggered a wave of criticism.
This move is not just pickin 'polymic, but it also describes a large blunder in the BUMN management that should be projecting integrity, competence, and legal justice.

Silfester, a convicted felon with a sentence of one year and six months of unexecuted prison, was appointed to a strategic position with a great salary. This decision raises the question: has the Ministry of the BUMN lost its moral compass and professionalism?
Case of Silfester Law: Situation and Quality · Global Voices
On May 20, 2019, the Supreme Court (MA) convicted Silfester Matutina of libel and slander against former Vice President Judila (JK).
In his order in front of Mages Polri on May 15, 2017, Silfester accused JK of using the issue SARA to support the Anies Baswedan- Sandiga Uo in Pilgub DKI Jakarta 2017.
These charges proved baseless, and the MA made a case against the South Jakarta State Court from one year to one year six months in prison.
However, until August 2025, Silfester had not yet undergone that sentence, despite the ruling of law-powered remains.
The Attorney General insists that the execution will be carried out by the South Jakarta District Attorney, although Silfester claims to have made peace with JK.
Personal peace doesn't remove legal obligations in a common criminal case. However, the absence of his execution for six years has sparked a speculation of political protection.
Social pressure is now increasing, with the public and activist urging Chain to execute the verdict immediately.
Social media, especially platform X, is being heard as a call for lawlessness, with many parties questioning why a convict is free and even occupying public office.
Meritocracy System failure
Silfester's ascension is not only problematic from the legal side, but also from a professional aspect of feasibility.
As an independent commissioner, an official is expected to have high integrity, clean track records, and relevant competence.
However, Silfester, known as President Joko Widodo and supporting the Prabowo-Gibran couple at Pilpres 2024, seems to be raised more because of political affiliations than capabilities.

The background of his education reaped the spotlight. The degree of law he received from the University of Indonesia, in which permission was revoked in 2023 due to the practice of fictitious college and sales - the diploma of his post depicts doubt about academic credibility.
Eks Wakapolri Komjen (Purn) Oegroseno, via Instagram upload on August 8, 2025, questioned the profiling process in the BUMN environment.

Did Silfester honestly convey his legal status? Did the Ministry of the BUMN check the Police Records or did the due diligence thoroughly? Otherwise, it shows systemic negligence in the rapture of public officials.
If Silfester's legal status is known but kept up, then this decision reflects willfully denial of the principle of good management.
Politics Accommodation or Food Detention?

Supporters, like the Gus Din (Gus Din) Alliance Volunteer Volunteer-Gibran, defend the rise of Silfester on the grounds that he was able to bridge between government and society in favor of food resistance programs, including free Bergizi Feeding (MBG).
This appointment is also referred to as part of the management and board commissioner's ID Food to strengthen the national food self-preservation.

However, the reason this feels weak in the midst of the fact that Silfester is a criminal who hasn't met his legal obligation, plus the public pressure which is now addressed to the bull to act immediately.

This Eick Thohir move is hard to get out of the political context of a 2024 election. As Jokowi's loyalist and part of the National Campaign Team (TKEN) Prabow--Gibran, Silfester seems to have earned a loving reward for his loyalty.
However, this kind of political accommodation is only destructive to the public belief in the Ministry of the BUMN, which should be an example in the management of the state company.
The Food ID, which has a strategic role in the food sector, requires a high-integrity figure, not someone who carries the burden of law and controversy.
Blunder's Depensive
Blunder Eirick Thohir in Silfester's case was not only about raising troubled individuals, but also about signals being sent to the public: that laws could be ruled out for political purposes.

The social pressure facing the Category now reflects the public unrest for this injustice. Clean Indonesian Movement Coordinator, Adhie Massardi, firmly calls this move the "love of crazy and enjoy justice spawning through her laundry at August 1, 2025.

If the Ministry of the BUMN is serious about upholding meritocracy and justice, the first step to do is revoke Silfester's appointment and ensure the process of transparent selection as well as free from political intervention.

This case is also a reminder that the BUMN management should not be compromised for short-term interests. Erick Thohir, known as jargon transformation of the BUMN, must immediately correct this blunder in order that public trust does not get more and more fermented.
The sergeant, on the other hand, must show his commitment to legal supremacy by immediately executing an incrah verdict, regardless of Silfester's political status.
The law must be enforced, and public office must be filled by those who truly deserve love not those who are protected by political connections.
